answer_1.quote: We introduce PROXYQA, a framework designed to evaluate LLMs' ability to generate long-form text.
answer_1.outputs: long-form texts such as reports and articles

answer_2.quote: The objective assessment of these reports is subsequently anchored to the precision of the GPT evaluator.

answer_3.quote: We utilize GPT-4 and its variant, GPT-4-Turbo (GPT-4-1106-Preview), are utilized as evaluators.
methods: answer proxy-questions based on generated content

answer_4.quote: Five well-educated postgraduate students are engaged; all have not participated in annotating the meta and proxy-questions of PROXYQA; they are required to score and rank the randomly sampled reports generated by different LLMs.
answer_4.guideline: Please rate the knowledge coverage of the reports provided, using a scale of 0-5. Assess how well the report covers the necessary information related to the question.
